title: Rosa from Amigos Tours is an amazing Seville local guide!
text: We signed up for the 4hr Seville Cathedral and Alcazar tour this week with 2 other couples and Rosa, our bright, friendly, knowledgable and fun local guide with a great sense od humour. She knew the in-depth history of both places and shared funny, inspirational stories that helped us understand the history and politics of the time these were built. She was engaging, patient, positive and unrushed ... she told us at the beginning that tours are not for rushing and we were free to take pauses for photos and questions, and she gave us appropriate break times. We came away feeling like we wanted
author: Wub84

title: In depth personal tours of Alcazar and the Cathedral
text: We did private tours of each on two consecutive days.  Each tour was two hours, though I wish these could have been longer,  Both guides, Sara and Nicholas, were friendly and highly knowledgeable university instructors who made history come alive as fascinating stories about Ferdinand III and Pedro the Cruel, historical figures new to us.  The stories made the sites come alive.  The mudejar style is exquisite.  The insights from our  guides deepened our appreciation of the blending of cultures which created this unique and beautiful style and made our visit even more memorable.
author: Resort729146

title: Alcazar and Cathedral of Seville Private Tour
text: Absolutely beautiful and mesmerizing, the Alcazar was my favorite and the Cathedral of Seville was my husband’s favorite.  They were, in a word, amazing!  We were lucky to have Pablo as our guide for the afternoon.  He was perfect for history buffs like me as he told stories of the multicultural history of Seville and how it pertained to the architecture and history displayed in these ancient buildings. title: Alcazar and Cathedral tour
text:
What a great day... We visited Alcazar and the Catedral de Sevilla and Rosa was the perfect guide! Informative, patient and helpful. 

We started to meet at 9:00 and because she had the tickets we were quickly inside Alcazar which we visited first. The microphone and headsets were functional to keep both the group together and give you space to manouver around. 

Thanks Amigo Tours, thanks Rosa!
